acceptanceCriteria: A reproduction pinned to a revision and index is recorded.
A task naming a requirement ID present in REQUIREMENTS.tsv yields that spec/requirement as evidence, or an explicit abstention naming why.
A stale index is reported in the packet rather than silently used.
body: Observed 2026-10-11 by the V1-0040 slice-2 lane (branch claude/v1-0040-slice2, Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 456). Expected: context for a task naming requirement IDs (STR-V0-008, STR-V0-013) at HEAD either answers from an index at HEAD or reports the staleness and abstains; requirement IDs are specific terms that route to the spec rows in docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv. Actual: the packet was built from index revision a29258ae (not HEAD) and returned `no-specific-terms`. Related: V1-1269 (slice-1 packet missed relevant files). Suspected defect until reproduced at a pinned revision.
title: context: `corvint context --task` answered from a stale index revision and found no terms in a task naming STR-V0-008 and STR-V0-013
